Card Q&A.a: Yes, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If cards that are targets of this effect are revealed from the deck, do I have to add as many cards to my hand as possible?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait and 1 red Tamer card with inherited effects among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon or Tamers digivolve into Digimon with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait, gain 1 memory.
